previous_top.item: Videos that are not in a post (own upload preview, direct messages) or for which X's data never arrives are covered as 'not verified' with no remedy; Play can end in 'Can't open this one in a new tab' (content.js:191,208,243).

Typing a display name ('John Smith') allows two unrelated accounts (@john, @smith); a shared post link allows '@i'; 'x.com/name' without https is refused although the hint says 'a profile link' (popup.js:53-60; popup.html:44).
previous_top.reason: Display names and the listed X paths are refused, scheme-less links accepted. Left: the path list is fixed (other X pages still pass) and real accounts with a listed handle cannot be added.

previous_top.item: In small tiles the cover hides its text line, so every failure notice ('Can't open', 'Couldn't open the tab', 'extension was updated') and the reason for the cover are invisible; the mode is fixed when the cover is created (content.js:197,179-191; content.css:20).
previous_top.reason: Failure notes now show in small tiles and the mode is re-decided on every check; it does not react to a resize without a DOM change, and width is ignored.

previous_top.item: Player shows 'Still loading. Check your connection, or pick a lower quality above.' when it should not: 10 s after the 'couldn't be loaded' error, while merely waiting for the user to press play, and when there is no quality menu (player.js:60,66-78; player.html:29).
previous_top.reason: Not after a failure, not while paused, no quality hint with one file. Side effect: no notice during a stalled quality switch.

previous_top.item: The 'reload this tab' help exists only inside the popup for the tab in front; a user who installs and sees nothing happen on X gets no hint, and on phones where the popup is its own page the banner never shows (popup.js:27-35).
When X gave no file, Play opens the full X post page instead of the player, and the video is covered again after 15 minutes even mid-watch (background.js:21-23; content.js:119).
An older saved entry that the new rules reject (e.g. a pasted link) makes the popup open with 'Not saved yet' and refuses every Save until the user deletes that line (popup.js:39,71-75,190-193).
previous_top.reason: No migration; entries such as 'i' or 'home' saved by the previous build are now rejected as well.

previous_top.item: Leaving the popup during the 15 s wait still cancels everything, and repeated taps at the end land on 'Keep blocking' (popup.js:142-143,159,169-172).
Follow/unfollow made in the X app or another tab, or a pending follow request, is not reflected correctly until reload (inject.js:98-104).

Storage reads that never answer leave the popup grey for ever, or make Save do nothing; only the write has a 4 s give-up, and its late success flips 'Couldn't save' to 'Saved' on its own (popup.js:13-23,91-98,184-186).
previous_top.reason: The initial read gives up after 4 s with a message; Save's read has no limit and a late write still flips 'Couldn't save' to 'Saved'.

top: Videos that are not in a post (own upload preview, direct messages), or for which X's data never arrives, are covered as 'not verified' with no remedy; Play can end in 'Can't open this one in a new tab' (content.js:191,208,243).
Installing with X already open changes nothing on the page; the reload help exists only inside the popup for the tab in front, and not when the popup is its own page (popup.js:27-35).
When X gave no file, Play opens the full X post page instead of the player, and the video is covered again after 15 minutes even mid-watch (background.js:21-23; content.js:119).

A saved entry that the current rules reject (older pasted link, or 'i'/'home' from the previous build) shows 'Not saved yet' on opening and makes every Save fail until that line is deleted (popup.js:39,59,71-75,190-193).
Leaving the popup during the 15 s wait cancels everything, and repeated taps at the end land on 'Keep blocking' (popup.js:142-143,159,169-172).
Follow or unfollow done in the X app or another tab is not reflected until reload (inject.js:98-104).

If X drives its vertical video feed or swipe-down-to-close with its own code, a vertical swipe that starts on a cover no longer reaches X and the user can get stuck on a covered item (content.js:292-319). Needs a device test.
broken_by_these_edits: Player: a quality switch that stalls before the new file's metadata shows no 'Still loading' notice, because the element is paused during the switch (player.js:73,91-95).

Popup: a real account whose handle equals a listed X path (@home, @share, @search, @i, ...) can no longer be added; names saved by the previous build that are now on the list make every Save fail until deleted (popup.js:44-45,59,190-193).
Popup: several names on one line separated by spaces are now rejected as one invalid entry (popup.js:53).
change_1_4_1_notes: Since the narrowed fix only vertical touch moves of a drag that started on a cover are hidden (content.js:292-319). Gone from the earlier costs: sideways swipes, presses/lifts, mouse input and the per-event closest() on every move (moves now return at once unless a drag is tracked). Remaining: vertical swipes in X's own gesture surfaces, double-tap zoom removed by touch-action: manipulation (content.css:8), and ancestor touch-action limits.
The overlay's own stop listeners for pointerdown/pointerup/touchstart/touchend (content.js:160-161) run again, so presses/lifts still reach only X's capture-phase listeners - same as before 1.4.1.

Tracking: started only for a single touch landing on a cover (content.js:299-302); any extra finger clears it; cleared on touchend/touchcancel when no finger is left (content.js:317-319); overwritten by every touchstart, so it cannot leak into the next gesture. In Chrome the touch pointermove precedes touchmove; both feed the same decision (content.js:304-316).

Direction: decided once from the first move with `>=`, so zero or exactly diagonal movement counts as vertical (content.js:311). The comment's reliance on Chrome's touch slop does not hold for browsers that report small first moves.
X sees press and lift without moves in a vertical drag from a cover; whether any X code then treats it as a tap is not determinable (Chrome's pointercancel is not filtered).
